scope: crib viz (packages/ui/web) — every state reachable in Phases 0, 1, 2 and 4
statuses: open | deferred | fixed (awaiting independent retest) | verified (retested by the independent assessor)

issues.title: Selecting a graph node, Focus and Blast require a pointer on the canvas
issues.reproduction: Load crib viz; with the keyboard only, try to open the inspector for a specific symbol. No keyboard path reaches a node: search results, Focus rings and Blast exist only as canvas pixels.
issues.evidence: ui-remediation-baseline.browser.ts "a keyboard user can enter the textual symbol explorer" (expected failure)

issues.title: The canvas graph (nodes, relationships, Focus rings, Blast) has no equivalent text presentation
issues.reproduction: Inspect the stage with a screen reader: the canvas is announced by its interim label only; relationships drawn on it are not available as text outside the inspector of one selected node.
issues.evidence: Interim role="img" label added in Phase 6; full equivalence is the Phase 3 List view

issues.title: Panning the canvas and moving nodes require dragging
issues.reproduction: On the stage, try to move the view without dragging: zoom and fit buttons exist, but no single-pointer control pans.
issues.owner: Phase 3 (deferred) — List view or pan controls

issues.title: A zero-result graph search offers no Clear search action
issues.reproduction: Search for "no-such-symbol-2026": the status reads "No graph matches" with no recovery control.

issues.title: Memory home counts, next action, conflict banner, pending/resume chips and actions used accent literals (1.5–2.9:1 light, 3.9–4.3:1 dark)
issues.reproduction: Open Memory in the light theme; sample the tile counts, Admit/Dismiss/Mark done and the standing chips.

issues.title: Inspector kind label, section titles, relation phrases and provenance badges in the light theme (1.05–2.7:1)
issues.reproduction: Select a node in the light theme and sample the inspector header and sections.

issues.title: Canvas hover tooltip kind label (2.3:1) and dimmed 11.5px summary
issues.reproduction: Hover a node in the light theme.

issues.title: "No graph matches" status text at 2.77:1 in the light theme
issues.reproduction: Search for a term with no matches in the light theme.

issues.title: Inspector section toggles were 17px tall; phone Memory detail controls 26–32px
issues.reproduction: Select a node; measure the Horizon/Depends on toggles. At 375px open a Memory record and measure Back, Inspect, Report a concern.

issues.title: DOM order put the stage overlay controls before the header, so Tab visited them before Search
issues.reproduction: Tab from the top of the page.
issues.evidence: phase-6-keyboard.browser.ts "every desktop tab stop…" asserts Search precedes the stage controls

issues.title: Tab escaped Memory, the phone drawer and the phone inspector past the inert background to the browser chrome
issues.reproduction: Open Memory; press Tab repeatedly past its last control.

issues.title: Inspector section and Source disclosure buttons did not expose their expanded state
issues.reproduction: Select a node; inspect the Horizon toggle in the accessibility tree.
issues.evidence: aria-expanded bound to the open state

issues.title: Canvas hover tooltip could not be dismissed without moving the pointer, could not be hovered, and was positioned over the node itself
issues.reproduction: Hover a node, press Escape; move the pointer onto the tooltip.
issues.evidence: phase-6-keyboard.browser.ts "canvas hover content can be hovered and dismissed"

issues.title: Single-key shortcuts M and F fired anywhere and could not be turned off
issues.reproduction: With focus outside a text field, say or type "m".
issues.evidence: Help popover switch (persisted); modified keys never trigger; phase-6-keyboard.browser.ts

issues.title: The graph search result count was not announced
issues.reproduction: Type a search with a screen reader running.

issues.criterion: 1.4.3 Contrast; 1.4.10 Reflow; 2.4.2 Page Titled; 3.1.1 Language of Page; 2.4.6 Headings
issues.title: Phase 0 audit findings: light-stage contrast 3.00:1, phone rail unreachable at 320px, no lang/title
issues.evidence: phase-1-shell.browser.ts; retest needed by the independent assessor
